login.title: Login
login.ribbon: Trusted supplier & shopper portal · Configuration-driven screens (demo)
login.lede: Sign in with the verified email and password for your account. Your role (shopper or vendor) is determined from that account — not chosen here.

enterprise.headline: Run sarees today, groceries and LPG tomorrow on one rails
enterprise.intro: Operators are consolidating storefronts, dark stores, and route logistics onto unified order and identity stacks. Nistta is built as configuration-first commerce so you can swap vertical packs without rewriting screens — ideal when categories expand from high-touch apparel to repeat grocery baskets and regulated cylinder fulfilment.

trends.title: Omnichannel truth, not slides
trends.body: Buyers research on mobile, pay with UPI, and expect the same profile whether they checkout as a guest or sign in later. Your stack should treat identity and consent as shared services.

trends.title: Quick commerce discipline
trends.body: SLA-driven fulfilment windows, cut-offs, and exception handling are table stakes. JSON-driven forms let you tune capture fields per city or hub without redeploying the host app.

trends.title: Trust & verification
trends.body: GST-linked vendors, KYC-light shoppers, and auditable contact roles reduce chargebacks and failed deliveries — capture them once at onboarding, re-use everywhere.

enterprise.footerNote: Roadmap: plug grocery catalogues and LPG subscription cycles into the same shell — business rules stay in JSON packs per vertical.

vendorSignup.title: Vendor registration
vendorSignup.lede: Create portal credentials first (login name + password), then business, GST, address, and contact rows — those credentials are what you will use on Sign in.

shopperSignup.title: Shopper profile
shopperSignup.lede: Set portal login name and password, then profile and delivery details — reuse them on Sign in.

settings.title: Settings
